oracle: Every raw Pydantic field, scalar type/float bits, mapping/container type/order, alias topology, input mutations and failures. Source-root substitution is restricted to traceback fields. Independent expected values and relation endpoints are also checked.
warmup_and_validation: Initialization, warmup, GC-before-run and all serialization/validation are excluded from measured intervals. Normal GC remains enabled during timing. CPU and wall seconds retained.
interference_policy: No test, profiling or extra interpreter runs in the measured Docker cgroup during this primary run. Earlier empty-filter run has a one-off import probe and is not evidence for the current candidate.
publication: Local only; no push or PR before 2026-10-30 Europe/Madrid.
